cohort: 106 patients who presented with normal or assisted vaginal delivery or caesarean section to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of Deben Mahata Government Medical College, Purulia, West Bengal, from July 2019 to December 2020.
finding: PPIUCD is a safe, convenient, and highly effective postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device, which can be integrated with maternal child health services.
mod_finding: PPIUCD can be encouraged in both vaginal delivery and Cesarean section.
